newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips set to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips set to open mixed.

text.p: The Dow Industrials were expected to open mixed Monday, gleaning some support from higher futures and steadier bonds, traders said.
The Dow closed 247 points lower Friday at 7695, losing three percent of its value after the dollar slid and fears rose over future blue chip earnings.
Monday, the long bond was up 2/32 to yield 6.54 percent. S&P 500 futures built on earlier gains and were up 4.65 points at 903.45.
It was unclear if below-expectation earnings announced by Hewlett-Packard Monday would have much general market fallout.
Some U.S. tech stocks were lower in London overnight trading, and Hewlett stock fell in pre-opening trade Monday.
"The focus is away from earnings and maybe on rates right now," said Warren Epstein, director of trading at Richard Rosenblatt.
